description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and an unspecified metric across four different categories: Tutorials, Library Documentation, StackOverflow posts, and Github files. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Tokens" with a linear scale, ranging from 200 to 800, and tick labels at intervals of 200. The y-axis has a linear scale, ranging from 10 to 40, with tick labels at intervals of 10, but lacks a label. The plot displays four lines, each representing one of the categories: Tutorials (blue, solid line, circle markers), Library Documentation (red, solid line, circle markers), StackOverflow posts (yellow, solid line, circle markers), and Github files (green, solid line, circle markers). The blue line (Tutorials) starts at approximately 22 and increases to around 30 at 800 tokens. The red line (Library Documentation) begins at about 25 and rises to roughly 32 at 800 tokens. The yellow line (StackOverflow posts) starts at approximately 33, decreases to around 12 at 800 tokens. The green line (Github files) begins at about 30, peaks at around 33 at 800 tokens, and then slightly decreases.
